desc:
Welcome to NO JUMPING OBBY! This game is like any normal difficulty chart obby... except you can't jump! Only 1% of players win! Can you beat the game without rage quitting?

Inspired by No Jumping Difficulty Chart Obby! 🎉

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shiftlock (Shift, LT)
